title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure signal below threshold.
fullDescription: Triumph Keihin/Sagem ECU detects MAP voltage below the calibrated minimum. Common on Tiger and Bonneville triples and twins.

fixSteps.title: Check hose
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect vacuum hose between throttle bodies and MAP sensor.

fixSteps.title: Probe sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Verify 5V reference and ground at MAP connector.

faq.a: Yes but with reduced performance until repaired.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor Low
shortDescription: ECT sensor signal voltage below threshold.
fullDescription: Coolant temperature sensor showing implausibly cold reading. ECU reverts to default fuel map.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Check ECT connector for water intrusion or corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Resistance test
fixSteps.instruction: ECT cold resistance approx 2.5k ohms; hot approx 250 ohms.

faq.a: Possibly, since fan logic is impaired.

title: Lambda Sensor Malfunction Bank 1
shortDescription: Upstream O2 sensor signal not switching.
fullDescription: Lambda sensor signal stuck or response too slow. Triumph ECU cannot maintain closed-loop fueling.

fixSteps.title: Inspect exhaust
fixSteps.instruction: Check headers and cat for leaks.

fixSteps.title: Heater test
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm 12V at heater pin key on.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new lambda sensor with anti-seize.

faq.a: Not for road bikes; closed-loop tuning depends on it.

title: Fuel Pump Relay Circuit
shortDescription: Fuel pump relay control circuit fault.
fullDescription: Triumph fuel pump relay or its control circuit has failed. Pump may not run or may run continuously.

fixSteps.title: Reset tip-over sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle key off/on; tip-over sensor resets after upright.

fixSteps.title: Swap relay
fixSteps.instruction: Swap fuel pump relay with horn relay to test.

fixSteps.title: Check wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect harness between relay and ECU.

whenToCallPro: If wiring repair needed in the harness.

faq.a: Many Triumphs cut fuel after a fall; cycle key to reset.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Low
shortDescription: Short to ground on cylinder 1 injector circuit.
fullDescription: ECU detects cyl 1 injector circuit shorted to ground. The injector or wiring may be faulty.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Lift tank, look for chafe at airbox and frame.

faq.a: Driving with a dead cylinder can foul cat; repair promptly.

title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: Cam sensor signal missing or erratic.
fullDescription: ECU cannot identify cylinder phase. Engine may start in batch-fire mode but ride poorly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Locate cam sensor on cylinder head; reseat connector.

whenToCallPro: If timing chain or tone wheel suspected.

faq.a: No, separate sensor on the camshaft.

title: EVAP Purge Valve Circuit
fullDescription: EVAP purge valve circuit open or shorted on US/CA spec Triumphs.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor
fullDescription: Speedometer or VSS-derived strategies fail. ABS and TC may also be inactive.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Check sensor on countershaft or front wheel for damage.

whenToCallPro: If ABS module flag persists after repair.

faq.a: Yes, ABS uses wheel speed signals; codes overlap.

title: Air Temperature Sensor Plausibility
fullDescription: Triumph-specific code: intake air temp differs significantly from ambient temperature sensor reading.

fixSteps.title: Reset and retest
fixSteps.instruction: Clear codes after engine fully cool.

fixSteps.title: Resistance check
fixSteps.instruction: Compare IAT and ambient sensor resistance at same temperature.

faq.a: Yes parking after a hot ride can briefly trigger plausibility.

title: Immobilizer Communication Fault
shortDescription: ECU cannot communicate with key transponder.
fullDescription: Triumph immobilizer (IMMO) handshake failed. Bike may crank but not start, or shut down quickly.

fixSteps.title: Try spare key
fixSteps.instruction: Use second key to verify it isn't a key chip issue.

fixSteps.title: Inspect antenna
fixSteps.instruction: Check antenna ring around ignition switch.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair keys
fixSteps.instruction: Have dealer pair keys with Triumph diagnostic tool.

whenToCallPro: Programming a new key requires Triumph diagnostic tool.

faq.a: Dealer must program a new transponder; bring proof of ownership.
